home.intro_html: I am a second-year Ph.D. student in mathematics at the University of Washington, Seattle. I work with Jarod Alper and Sara Billey. I am interested in the intersection of algebraic geometry, homotopy theory, and combinatorics. Recently, I became interested in visualizing mathematics using 3D printing.
